Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join assays on chembl_id CHEMBL3885882, join activities on assay_id, join molecule_dictionary on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno. Filter activities where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Return all matching rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
